results.title: Kinetic Engineering To Invest ₹57 Crore, Driven By EV Scooter And Driveline Export Orders
results.description: Kinetic Engineering Limited (KEL) announced on Wednesday an additional investment of ₹57 crore to boost its electric two-wheeler segment and driveline business for exports. This investment is the final tranche of converting 44.51 lakh warrants issued to promoters in March 2025.

results.title: Adani Group to invest over ₹1 trillion across sectors in West Bengal
results.description: The conglomerate will invest across ports, logistics, energy, roads, green cement and data centres, while its Rs 4,000-crore hospital project is under way in New Town
